why: The single declaration of who this service is. The DNS-rebinding guard, both probe workflows, the HTTP entry test and the production verifier each carried their own domain literal, and they disagreed: the guard allowed qesis-mcp.vercel.app while three consumers used qesis-public.vercel.app, so a correct deployment answered HTTP 421 to its own test suite. Every consumer reads this file. scripts/verify_domains.py fails the build if a domain literal appears anywhere that is not declared here.
note: qesis.eu answers 308 to www.qesis.eu, so www is the serving name. VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL resolves to the shortest domain and is therefore not sufficient on its own; it is still appended at runtime from the environment.
